hits.title: FriskAI launches with $3.6M to show enterprises what their AI agents are doing - SiliconANGLE
hits.snippet: MaC Venture Capital Management led FriskAI’s round. Wischoff Ventures joined, along with New Enterprise Associates Inc. partner Rick Yang and a group of angel investors.
